summary: Plymouth County tower on Bare Hill, built 1988 and run by the Bureau of Forest Fire Control; unstaffed at a 2014 visit; its older Carver tower closed in 1986.

facts.design: 80-foot tubular steel tower with a slant-window cab and no door onto the catwalk
facts.status_note: The most recent visit report read is dated March 24, 2014; no newer condition report found
facts.agency: Massachusetts Bureau of Forest Fire Control

access.note: State-run tower; the register notes no NHLR sign at the site and no signed directions; no public visiting arrangement found in the sources read

events.note: Old 38-foot tower moved from Chelmsford to this site (firetower.org; the FFLA post gives 1919)
New 68-foot iron tower built at the older site (firetower.org; the FFLA post gives 1932)
Older tower closed at the end of the 1986 fire season
Current tower on Bare Hill built in 1988 (NHLR)
Older tower dismantled and moved to a farm in Minnesota
Registered May 19, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg
Register visit report March 24, 2014: not staffed in several years; backup solar panels damaged; needs paint

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register writes Miles Standish State Forest; the state forest is Myles Standish, as the FFLA post writes it. The story uses Myles.

notes_for_editor: Unresolved: the older tower's move and build dates differ (firetower.org 1918 and 1930; FFLA post 1919 and 1932), so both are given. The FFLA post places the older tower along Lower College Pond Road, while firetower.org gives SW Line Road; treated as the same older tower because both record the 1986 closure and 2002 move. NHLR says 80 ft; a second FFLA post seen only as a search snippet says 85 ft, not used because the page could not be read. The FFLA posts about the 2000 and 2017 photos returned only a login wall, so no post-2014 condition is confirmed. A 1957 Carver forest fire appears on the Carver Fire Department history page, but no source read ties the tower to it, so it is omitted. No photos recorded.
